sloka: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये ।तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। ७.९७.१६ ॥
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā yathā rāmaṁ samarcaye ।tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṁ dātumarhati ।। 7.97.16 ॥

translations.english: Sita prayed, "Just as I worship Rama with my mind, actions, and speech, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."
